title: Let praise dye the whole life true
summary: This meets the self-consciousness comparison keeps hardening. The line says praise and saintly company should dye the whole life truthful.
takeaway: Let praise and company dye conduct true.
lifeApplication: Before polishing the outside again, return to praise with those who keep the heart honest. Let one truthful act in saintly company soak deeper than display.

source.shortMeaning: Praise and saintly company dye conduct with truth.
source.lifeApplication: Before polishing the outside, return to praise and one truthful act.

evidence.coreClaim: Praise and saintly company dye conduct with truth.
evidence.turn: Let praise, saintly company, and true action soften the self into homecoming.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before polishing the outside again, return to praise with those who keep the heart honest. Let one truthful act in saintly company soak deeper than display.
